policy: Inspect the complete returned response for each exact prompt; do not use the selected-option regex as a semantic grade.

Strict pass requires the correct main answer, correct requested reasoning/calculation, every substantive requested component, and no unresolved material contradiction or factual error in supporting text.
A uniquely identifying correct option value can pass without its letter; retain a missing_option_letter flag. An explicitly wrong option label fails strict grading.

When a prompt explicitly requests a check, require a genuinely distinct numerical method or a numerical inverse/back-check/substitution. A single derivation, repetition of it, or a bare claim that it checks out is insufficient.
A self-correction can pass when the incorrect claim is resolved and the final conclusion is clear. A correct final sentence alone does not erase unretracted conflicting explanations.

Core-answer correctness is a separate, non-composite diagnostic: the main numerical result or scientific conclusion is correct, irrespective of omitted verification or faulty supporting claims. It is not a strict pass and does not establish tutoring quality.

A token-limit finish is not automatically wrong if the complete requested answer already appears. Repetition and length-format excess are flagged, not independently deducted. Missing substantive material at the limit fails.
This is an analyst-defined binary audit of a raw-completion stress test, not a chat-template evaluation, official benchmark accuracy, panel grade, or competition score.
Review-boundary flags identify discretionary explanation/safety judgments for a second reviewer; the stated provisional binary decision remains visible rather than being silently omitted.
Assess all returned raw-completion text, including literal <think> blocks and text preceding </think>. This differs from the judges chat test's final-answer-only policy.
An actual inverse check of a relevant intermediate constraint can satisfy a requested check; independently checking every substep is not required.

original_option_parser.note: Preserved stored regex option flags, not this manual semantic grade.

independent_review.scope: The primary assessor read all 100 full responses; independent reviewers examined selected disputed cases and shared grading boundaries, not all 100 responses independently.
reviewed_decisions: Root confirmed Q4_0 M26 inverse profit/rate check is valid.
Independent grader confirmed Q4_0 M12 contradictory labels and M50 incorrect named fallacy fail strict grading.
Independent grader confirmed S11 and S25 pass: relevant unit/pH contrasts satisfy the explanation requirement without mandatory technical keywords.
Root and independent grader confirmed S09 passes: it substantively contrasts the other simple-machine mechanisms, beyond repeating the ramp definition.
Root clarified that a distinct numerical method can satisfy a requested check, as can inverse arithmetic or substitution; repeated derivations alone cannot.

Independent grader confirmed M43 still fails strict grading after that clarification: the later bare product and addition repeat the partial-products derivation without showing a distinct verification method.

A second independent grader read full S34, S36, S42, S47 and S49 responses; confirmed S34/S42/S47/S49 strict failures with core credit. Root adjudicated S36 as a strict pass because its correct substantive evidence meets the prompt despite weak supplementary colour-change evidence.
